definitions.explanation: People who belong to the same generational cohort or are roughly the same age. Used to describe shared experiences, perspectives, or connections among people of similar age.

examples.japanese: {同世代|どうせだい}の{友人|ゆうじん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I have many friends of the same generation.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}とは{同世代|どうせだい}なので{話|はなし}が{合|あ}う。
examples.english: Since she's the same generation as me, we get along well in conversation.

examples.japanese: {同世代|どうせだい}の{選手|せんしゅ}が{活躍|かつやく}しているのを{見|み}ると、{自分|じぶん}も{頑張|がんば}ろうという{気持|きも}ちになる。
examples.english: When I see athletes of the same generation doing well, it makes me want to try harder too.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {同|どう} (same) + {世代|せだい} (generation). Used as a noun modifier ({同世代|どうせだい}の) or predicatively. Common in discussions about generational identity and shared cultural experiences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同世代|どうせだい}の{人|ひと} (people of the same generation)
- {同世代|どうせだい}に{人気|にんき} (popular among the same generation)
- {同世代|どうせだい}の{仲間|なかま} (peers of the same generation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同年代|どうねんだい}: same age range — very similar, slightly more focused on specific age
- {同期|どうき}: same class year — people who joined an organization at the same time
